SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

5. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   B. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   D. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   B. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   D. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

8. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   C. Treat School administration as rumours only.
   D. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain African Traditional Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. B — Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. D — Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Plan income and spending wisely

11. A — Nairobi

12. A — Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Population distribution in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of African Traditional Education; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
